name: smwgraphics-r-ack-omh-16x16-one-way-walls
title: R-ACK / ~omh~ - 16x16 One-Way Walls
description:
One-Way walls, as seen in both R-ACK and ~omh~ to convey a block that blocks mario from crossing a specific side. Nice if you don't want a custom palette or animation.

You should use these blocks if you intend on using the graphic in your own hack. (You can technically also set the 'top' one to act like a cloud or tile 100)
